# The delete button of the model panel (437, DeleteSelectedModel): links to
# the deleted slot (accessory parent and its keys) are cut, the combo order
# above it moves down, and the scene enters camera mode.
load model chain8.pmx
load model lips.pmd
load model morph4.pmx
load accessory .\tri.x
select camera
select accessory tri.x
accessory parent lips 首
frame 10
register accessory
save pmm three.pmm

select model lips
delete model
save pmm deleted-lips.pmm

select model chain8
delete model
save pmm deleted-chain8.pmm
